title: The merge tool's review-record post runs the hook catalog check on the head and refuses to post on red
why: A stale hook catalog reaches the batch with a review record on it, and CI then turns the whole batch red.
note: Run `python3 lint/hook_catalog.py --check` on the head, as the post now runs ste-lint (decision ste-lint-at-push). Incident: #1687 got a review record and went to runner 8 with the catalog check red (coordinator, 19:36 CST Nov 7). Given to lane lint-before-record-push, still open, 19:36 CST; status todo until the lane starts it.
